req.title: Return PATCH request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to PATCH /patch with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that PATCH /patch returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, and origin. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — plain PATCH with no body returns all required keys with correct status; (2) positive EP — PATCH with JSON body reflects json field correctly; (3) positive EP — PATCH with form data reflects form field; (4) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (GET) on /patch returns 405; (5) boundary BVA — PATCH with empty body yields data='' and json=null; (6) DT — PATCH with query string reflects args field exactly; (7) NEG — PATCH with malformed JSON body yields json=null not an error. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant, operator, and key-name mutations.

tests.name: test_patch_returns_200_with_all_required_keys
actions: Send PATCH /patch with no body via test client
expected: JSON body contains exactly keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — response must include all eight metadata fields
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_returns_200_with_all_required_keys():
    r = client.patch('/patch')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    required_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    assert set(body.keys()) == required_keys

test_patch_returns_200_with_all_required_keys()

tests.name: test_patch_with_json_body_reflects_json_field
actions: Send PATCH /patch with Content-Type application/json and body {"key": "value"}
expected: data field contains the raw JSON string
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — json field must reflect parsed JSON payload
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_with_json_body_reflects_json_field():
    payload = json.dumps({"key": "value"})
    r = client.patch(
        '/patch',
        data=payload,
        content_type='application/json'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['json'] == {"key": "value"}
    assert body['data'] == payload
    assert body['form'] == {}

test_patch_with_json_body_reflects_json_field()

tests.name: test_patch_with_form_data_reflects_form_field
actions: Send PATCH /patch with application/x-www-form-urlencoded body field=hello
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — form field must reflect URL-encoded form payload
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_with_form_data_reflects_form_field():
    r = client.patch(
        '/patch',
        data={'field': 'hello'},
        content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['form'] == {'field': 'hello'}
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['data'] == ''

test_patch_with_form_data_reflects_form_field()

tests.name: test_patch_empty_body_yields_empty_data_and_null_json
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — boundary: zero-length payload; data and json must reflect absence of content
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_empty_body_yields_empty_data_and_null_json():
    r = client.patch('/patch', data=b'', content_type='application/octet-stream')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['args'] == {}

test_patch_empty_body_yields_empty_data_and_null_json()

tests.name: test_patch_malformed_json_body_yields_null_json_field
actions: Send PATCH /patch with Content-Type application/json but body is not valid JSON
expected: json field is null (not an error)
data field contains the raw malformed string
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — error pathway: malformed JSON must not crash; json field must be null
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_malformed_json_body_yields_null_json_field():
    bad_payload = b'{not valid json'
    r = client.patch(
        '/patch',
        data=bad_payload,
        content_type='application/json'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['data'] == '{not valid json'

tests.name: test_patch_url_field_contains_patch_path
actions: Send PATCH /patch and inspect url field in response
expected: url field is a string ending with '/patch'
origin field is present and is a string
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — url and origin fields must be present and correctly populated
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_url_field_contains_patch_path():
    r = client.patch('/patch')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(body['url'], str)
    assert body['url'].endswith('/patch')
    assert 'origin' in body
    assert isinstance(body['origin'], str)

test_patch_url_field_contains_patch_path()
